WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'P5' AS rng, SUM(net_sales) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales END) AS stores, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS web,
  (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id<>999) AS ctrl
FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Sep', SUM(net_sales), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales END), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END),
  (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND store_id<>999)
FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ret,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_web,
 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT MAX(return_date) FROM fact_return_line) AS max_ret,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.status IN ('cancelled','processing') AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-30') AS web_lines_undispatched,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) AS web_lines_no_order

SELECT d.fiscal_period_label, MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day, MAX(d.calendar_date) AS last_day,
 (SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')) AS excluded_999_zz_sales,
 (SELECT fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5) AS fully_loaded
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 GROUP BY 1
